_note: Finding ids frozen on 2026-11-19 BEFORE any analyzer code. Own rules written by CyberDat. Severity: high, medium, low, info (info = minor or informational, grouped). Results are based only on what the headers say; no DNS, WHOIS, reputation or signature check.

findings.meaning: a Received line could not be parsed; it is shown as is
time order of Received lines broken by more than 5 minutes
a Received date lies more than 15 minutes in the future
total delivery time from the first to the last Received line over 1 hour
no Received lines (headers incomplete or not delivered by SMTP)
a parsed Received line has no date
trusted DMARC result is fail
trusted SPF result is fail, softfail or permerror while DMARC did not pass
trusted DKIM result is fail or permerror while DMARC did not pass
no trusted authentication results for a message from outside (internal mail excluded)
authentication results that claim a pass were written below the trust boundary or by an unknown server
DMARC fail on a forwarded or mailing-list message (trusted arc=pass, or List-Id present); replaces AUTH-001/002/003
no trusted DMARC result and neither the SPF domain nor a DKIM domain aligns with From (relaxed, organizational domain via the Public Suffix List)
Return-Path organizational domain differs from From
Reply-To organizational domain differs from From
display name contains an address or domain that differs from the From address
display name names a brand from the CyberDat list but the From domain is not one of that brand's domains
From missing, empty or with more than one address
internationalized (punycode) domain in From, Reply-To or Return-Path
a domain label mixes scripts (for example Latin and Cyrillic)
From or Reply-To domain looks like a listed brand or the user's own domain (homoglyphs, digits, rn for m, one edit, or the brand inside the label)
no Message-ID
Message-ID domain differs from the From organizational domain
no Date
Date in the future, far from the delivery time, or with an impossible time zone
X-Mailer or User-Agent present
X-Originating-IP present
bulk or list mail (List-Unsubscribe, List-Id, Precedence bulk/list)
the message claims a listed brand (FROM-002 or LOOK-003 brand match) and authentication failed (AUTH-001, AUTH-002 with AUTH-003, or ALIGN-001)

brands: Own short list in the engine (BRANDS). Not part of the frozen catalogue.
